uistudio.evidence: UI Studio library probe record: https://github.com/mitsevox/nflstreet2/pull/7#issuecomment-5945092269 . ProDG 3.9.3 -O2 reproduces neighbouring functions 0x8021A020 and 0x8021C654 exactly; -O1, -Os and -fno-schedule-insns2 change both. -O3 is excluded by inference (it inlines same-file callees the target keeps as calls); -fno-strength-reduce changes 0x8021C654; -ffloat-store changes 0x8021CA54; -G0 changes 0x8021D880 and -G 16 changes 0x8021CA54 (default -G 8 fits). Not discriminated: -fno-schedule-insns and ProDG 3.5-3.9.3. Library scope rests on the target call graph and the shared error callback 0x803EBF30, with related-build file order.
